deviations_from_the_approved_plan.defect_found_afterwards_and_corrected: the sidecar recorded the digests of the committed originals, the staged copies and the in-place copies in one block using two different methods: the first two were sha256 of a sorted re-serialization of the parsed document and only the third was sha256 of raw file bytes. The committed originals therefore did not hash to what the sidecar said, and no common normalization reproduced it. The comparison itself never consumed those digests -- it compared git-show text against file text, then the parsed documents key by key -- so no gate was weakened, but a record that cannot be reproduced does not support the claim it was filed to support. Corrected in the sidecar's /correction block, which preserves the erroneous values, names the source commit, gives both correct raw sha256, states the verifying command, and re-establishes the substantive claim from raw bytes

development_split_refusal.message: the development and test images share 4 image byte-value(s), e.g. 6241c73fc92dcbd6bdd48c072a6886d0524ad8ceaa98dcebb0691fab77b4911a; a development split that overlaps the test images in CONTENT is not disjoint from them, and a configuration selected on it would be selected partly on the measurement it is supposed to be blind to

seed_budget_refusal.message: ppubench was asked for router seeds [42, 123] beyond the frozen g, but this dataset has no held-out image content, so those routers could only measure seed stability on repeated training bytes and no routing verdict would use them.  Item 3 spends the router-training budget on SALMU; freeze the ppubench pilot with router_seeds=[17]

ppubench_cannot_host_a_v5_pilot.what_this_means: PPUBench is not merely deferred: its held-out filenames are bytes that also appear in its train split, so no development split of it can be content-disjoint from its test images, and a configuration selected on one would be selected partly on the measurement it is supposed to predict.  v5 is therefore SALMU-only, and the route-seed cross it exists to run is only possible on a dataset with held-out image content
